description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM part mounts between the Targa upright and the Samurai body so that the Targa bar is sitting on rubber rather than the body metal.
This parts prevents rattling and rust from wear-thru.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1- Targa Bar Rubber Pad Seal (LH)
Qty 1- Targa Bar Rubber Pad Seal (RH)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
